inShort: A plays only topspin dinks, and B answers every one with slice to keep it low. After 5 minutes, swap roles.
rules: A and B stand diagonally at the kitchen line.
A plays only topspin dinks: brush up from low to high, like a windshield wiper.
B answers every ball with slice or a push (backspin, paddle face slightly open), low and toward the middle. Topspin back would sit up; slice keeps it low.
B takes the ball after the bounce, in front of the body and between the feet.
No pop-ups: every reply stays low over the net.
After about 5 minutes, swap roles. Then a free round: topspin back only when the ball is comfortable and out in front, otherwise slice.
tooEasy: Count low dinks in a row as a team, up to 15; three misses and you start again. Even harder: turn it around: A slices everything, B has to topspin everything.
tooHard: A plays slower with less spin, and nobody counts.
goodLooksLike: B's slice replies stay low over the net and land in the kitchen, even when A's topspin comes with pace.
